description: What agents asked for and did not get, ranked by how many asked and how recently: phrases and searches with no match, unknown barcodes. Free. Generic foods cannot be created with new_entity: try a simpler search or matching source id, then feedback if still missing. Fill a product, supplement or menu item when you have the item in hand or can open its own page: add_proof with new_entity {kind, name, brand, barcode}, market, url or files, and your reading. A need closes by itself once the database answers it.

kind.description: item: phrases and searches; barcode: unknown barcodes.

market.description: ISO 3166-1 country where the item is sold or eaten, e.g. US, GB, JP.

name: needs
